adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for deleteEvent around line 312-316, the code shows: `const calendarId = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. This is indeed a dead fallback - when externalCalendarId is falsy, the find condition `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` will be looking for a calendar where externalId equals a falsy value, which will never match a real calendar. This means calendarId will be undefined and fall back to defaultCalendarId ('primary'). The same pattern appears in updateEvent at line 253. This is a real bug where the fallback logic is broken.
